title.zh: Marathon Fusion成功实现「水银变黄金」炼金术，中长期或颠覆黄金基本面
title.en: Marathon Fusion成功实现「水银变黄金」炼金术，中长期或颠覆黄金基本面

current_state.zh: Marathon Fusion announced a beam-driven fusion process that converts mercury-198 into stable gold-197, claiming lab-scale output above 2 tonnes per GWth-year and only long-term potential to disrupt gold fundamentals.
current_state.en: Marathon Fusion announced a beam-driven fusion process that converts mercury-198 into stable gold-197, claiming lab-scale output above 2 tonnes per GWth-year and only long-term potential to disrupt gold fundamentals.
